intro: Buses are few, so it pays to plan ahead. Timetables change, so the links below go to live times rather than copying them here.

items.name: 564 family (LMS Travel)
items.route: Inkberrow, Radford, Rous Lench, Church Lench and Norton to Evesham railway station and bus station; some journeys run via Pershore.
items.days: Monday to Saturday, a few journeys a day.
items.stops: Rous Lench (church); Church Lench (Beehive Cottage, Low Road, Handgate Farm).

items.name: 28 (Stagecoach)
items.route: Harvington to Evesham, and the other way to Bidford and Stratford-upon-Avon.
items.stops: Harvington (Golden Cross, Coach & Horses, First School, Brickyard Cottages).

buses.note: Ab Lench, Atch Lench and Sheriffs Lench have no bus stop; the nearest are in Church Lench.

ondemand.name: Worcestershire on Demand
ondemand.text: A bookable minibus run by the county council. Book by app or phone up to five days ahead; it picks up from set points. Monday to Saturday, 7am to 7pm; £2.50 a journey, free with a bus pass.
ondemand.check: Check the zone map to see whether your address is covered.

community.intro: Volunteer drivers, door to door, for appointments, shopping and visits. No age limit; register first, and book ahead.

hospital.text: Hospital trips: NHS patient transport and help with travel costs

roads.text: Road closures and roadworks near the villages are listed on the News page and updated automatically.

passes.text: Older person's and disabled bus passes, and other bus information, come from Worcestershire County Council.
